s: Stateful stream processor delivering correct results on unbounded data with exactly-once guarantees.
w: Records flow through operator graphs with keyed state stored in RocksDB checkpoints. Event-time watermarks handle out-of-order arrivals; windows aggregate over event timestamps not wall clock. Two-phase-commit sinks give exactly-once end-to-end. Savepoints enable stateful upgrades/migrations. CEP library matches event patterns (fraud sequences).
use: Realtime fraud detection scoring transactions mid-flight
Sessionization of user clickstreams (dynamic session windows)

pat.d: Flink propagates slowdown upstream naturally - credit-based flow control.

pits: Checkpoint blowups from oversized state - TTL state, pre-aggregate, window properly
Watermark misconfig silently drops late data - set allowed lateness deliberately
tips: Event-time vs processing-time distinction separates seniors from juniors instantly
